description: This file implements the <iterate> element for the minilang language in the OFBiz framework. It defines the Iterate class, which executes a loop over a collection, iterator, or entity list, applying a set of sub-operations for each item.

classes.name: Iterate
classes.description: Implements the <iterate> tag operation in the minilang language, performing iteration over various collection types and executing sub-operations within the loop.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the iteration logic, looping over the collection or iterator specified by 'listFma', applying sub-operations for each element, and handling break/continue exceptions.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers artifact information from all sub-operations.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Iterate object, including its entry and list attributes.
